AIIMS Jammu Senior Resident/Demonstrator Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 86 Posts - Complete Details

The All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jammu (AIIMS Jammu) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 86 Senior Resident/Demonstrator. Candidates with DNB, M.Phil/Ph.D, MS/MD, DM Can Apply Online. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications from 19-09-2026 to 30-09-2026. The candidate shall apply online through AIIMS Jammu website, aiimsjammu.edu.in.

Important Dates

  • Cut-off Date for Eligibility : 30.09.2026 (Wednesday)
  • Notification Date : 17.09.2026
  • Cut-off Date for Determining Eligibility : 30.09.2026 (Wednesday)
  • Date(s) of Interview : To be notified separately
  • Burns & Plastic Surgery : MS/DNB in General Surgery/ENT/Orthopedics, or M.Ch/DNB (Plastic Surgery)

Application Fee

  • Recruiting Institute : All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Vijaypur, Jammu-181134
  • Posts : Senior Resident (Medical candidates) / Senior Demonstrator (Non-Medical candidates)
  • Application Fee : Not specified in this Cycle-2 notice; refer the base Rolling Advertisement (Employment Notification No. 03/2026)
  • Post Code : Department / Specialty
  • Anaesthesiology : Postgraduate medical degree (MD/DNB) in Anaesthesiology, or equivalent
  • Burns & Plastic Surgery : MS/DNB in General Surgery/ENT/Orthopedics, or M.Ch/DNB (Plastic Surgery)
  • Gastroenterology : MD/DNB in General Medicine/Paediatrics, OR DM/DNB (Gastroenterology)
  • General Medicine : MD/DNB in Medicine, or equivalent
  • General Surgery : MS/DNB in General Surgery, or equivalent
  • Hospital Administration : MD/DNB (after MBBS) in Hospital Administration, or equivalent
  • Obstetrics & Gynecology : MD/MS/DNB in Obstetrics & Gynecology, or equivalent
  • Surgical Gastroenterology : MS/DNB in General Surgery, OR M.Ch/DNB in G.I. Surgery

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
